shadowSentences: I enjoy reading books in my free time.
My favorite food is pizza with extra cheese.
I often go for a walk after dinner.
Traveling to new places is always exciting for me.
I like to listen to music while I study.
My best friend has a really great sense of humor.
I take an online course to improve my language skills.
Baking cookies on weekends is a fun activity for my family.
I often volunteer at a local animal shelter during summer.
Learning a new skill can be challenging but rewarding.

interviewScenarios.intro: You have agreed to take part in a research study about exercise habits.
questions: Q1: Can you describe your current exercise routine?
Q2: What challenges do you face when trying to stay active?
Q3: How important do you think exercise is for a healthy lifestyle?
Q4: What advice would you give someone who wants to start exercising?

interviewScenarios.intro: You have agreed to take part in a research study about eating habits.

interviewScenarios.intro: You have agreed to take part in a research study about travel experiences.
